src/kai_code/settings.py.description: Settings module with KaiSettings dataclass, load_settings(), and _read_json/_write_json helpers. Supports global/project/local settings with merge precedence. Session-specific fields: last_session, agents.

src/kai_code/rich_commands.py.description: Slash command handling via handle_command() function. Commands return "exit", None, "model_select", or prompt strings. Uses console.print() for output. Pattern: check command prefix, parse args, call handler, show feedback.
